Class OrderDAO

java.lang.Object
app.dao.OrderDAO
public class OrderDAO extends Object
Reads order history and reports, and persists orders with their items, modifications, and related inventory deductions.

  • Method Details

    • getOrders

      public List<Order> getOrders(OrderFilters filters, int limit, int offset) throws SQLException
      Retrieves a page of orders matching the supplied filters, newest first.

      Orders are sorted by timestamp descending, then identifier descending. The requested limit must be between 1 and 500; the offset is zero-based. The method obtains and closes its own database connection.

      Parameters:
      filters - optional order filters; individual null filter values are ignored
      limit - maximum number of orders to return
      offset - number of matching rows to skip
      Returns:
      matching orders on the requested page, or an empty list when no rows match that page
      Throws:
      SQLException - if database access or query execution fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if limit is outside 1..500 or offset is negative
      NullPointerException - if filters is null
      DateTimeException - if an end-date filter is the maximum representable date and the following day cannot be calculated

    • getSalesReport

      public SalesReportData getSalesReport(LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) throws SQLException
      Builds sales-report data for the inclusive date range, including item, daily, payment-method, and employee breakdowns and summary totals.

      Database timestamps are filtered from the start of startDate through, but not including, the start of the day after endDate. Revenue and average order value exclude sales tax. Estimated ingredient cost and gross profit are reported only when all required recipe and modification costs are available; otherwise the estimated profit in the summary is null and its completeness flag is false. The method uses one connection for its report queries and closes that connection before returning.

      Parameters:
      startDate - first calendar date to include
      endDate - last calendar date to include
      Returns:
      report data with empty breakdown lists and zero sales/order totals when no orders match
      Throws:
      SQLException - if database access or any report query fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if either date is null or startDate is after endDate
      DateTimeException - if endDate is the maximum representable date and the following day cannot be calculated

    • getSalesByItem

      private List<SalesReportRow> getSalesByItem(Connection conn, LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) throws SQLException
      Aggregates item quantities, sales revenue, ingredient cost, and estimated gross profit for the inclusive date range.

      Rows are sorted by revenue descending, then quantity sold descending, then item name ascending. Revenue includes recorded modification prices and excludes sales tax. Cost and profit are null for a row when any required item or modification ingredient cost is unavailable. The supplied connection remains owned by the caller.

      Parameters:
      conn - open connection to use for the query
      startDate - first calendar date to include
      endDate - last calendar date to include
      Returns:
      aggregated rows, possibly empty
      Throws:
      SQLException - if preparing or executing the query fails
      DateTimeException - if endDate is the maximum representable date and the following day cannot be calculated

    • buildWhereClause

      private String buildWhereClause(OrderFilters filters)
      Builds SQL conditions for the non-null fields in the order filters.

      Customer name and payment type use case-insensitive substring matching; employee ID uses equality. The start date is inclusive, while the end date is inclusive by calendar day through a next-day exclusive timestamp bound.

      Parameters:
      filters - order filters to inspect
      Returns:
      an empty string when no filters are set, or a WHERE clause containing parameter placeholders
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if filters is null

    • saveOrder

      public int saveOrder(int employeeId, String customerName, String paymentType, BigDecimal totalCost, BigDecimal salesTax, List<OrderItem> items)
      Saves an order, its items and modifications, and their inventory deductions in one database transaction.

      Identifiers are selected as the current maximum plus one. A SQL failure is rolled back, printed, and represented by -1; a successful commit returns the assigned order identifier. The method creates and closes its own connection.

      Parameters:
      employeeId - identifier of the employee recording the order
      customerName - customer name to store with the order
      paymentType - payment method to store with the order
      totalCost - total amount collected, including tax
      salesTax - tax included in totalCost
      items - order lines and their selected modifications
      Returns:
      the new order identifier, or -1 if a SQL failure prevents the transaction from completing
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if items, an order item, or a modification accessed while saving is null
